description: Use this when the user wants something done for them on a schedule — every day, on certain weekdays, or every few hours — e.g. 'every Monday at 9, summarise my sales sheet'. Creates a Xenition automation that runs on its own at those times, even when nobody is in this chat. Results appear in Xenition, and anything that would act in a connected app waits for the user's approval. Do not use for a one-off task now (use run_agent).

agent.description: optional agent slug from list_agents to run it; Xenition plans it otherwise

every.description: for every: an interval like '30m' or '6h' (15 minutes minimum)

name.description: a short name, e.g. 'Monday sales summary'

task.description: what the agent should do each time, in plain words — e.g. 'summarise last week's rows in my Sales sheet and draft an update'

time.description: HH:MM, 24-hour, for daily and weekly — e.g. '09:00'

timezone.description: IANA timezone for daily/weekly, e.g. 'Asia/Dhaka'; UTC if omitted

name: create_automation
title: Schedule an automation
